impact.text: this allows an attacker to fill all registry slots and then "dust" each vault, permanently locking the vault registry.

precondition_sources.text: A vault is registered in the WERC7575ShareToken vault registry.

intent_sources.text: The vault registry must not be permanently locked by filling all MAX_VAULTS_PER_SHARE_TOKEN slots and dusting each vault.
